fields.summary: TC-854-01: CA and FO on Same Trip Have Different Guarantee Credits Calculated Independently

content.text: Linked Story: CREWCMBR-854

Precondition: A trip has both a CA and an FO assigned. The CA and FO have different guaranteed pay minimums. The Phase 1 guarantee calculation must compute each crew member's guarantee independently based on their respective contract minimums, not using a single shared straight-time credit.
TEST STEPS
Step
Action
Test Data
Expected Result
Set up a trip with both CA and FO assigned where the CA guarantee minimum is 19.07 TFP and the FO guarantee minimum is 11.60 TFP, and the actual straight time trip credit is 13.00 TFP
Trip: straightTimeCredit=13.00 TFP. CA: guaranteeMinimum=19.07 TFP. FO: guaranteeMinimum=11.60 TFP
Trip record is set up with both CA and FO assignments and their respective guarantee minimums
Trigger Phase 1 COA processing for the trip
COA Step Function processing for the trip with CA and FO assignments
Phase 1 COA Step Function processes both CA and FO assignments independently
Verify the CA guarantee credit is calculated based on the CA's contract minimum (19.07 TFP), not the FO's minimum
CA straightTimeCredit=13.00 TFP < CA guarantee minimum 19.07 TFP
CA guarantee credit = 19.07 TFP (guaranteed up to CA minimum, not FO minimum)
Verify the FO guarantee credit is calculated based on the FO's contract minimum (11.60 TFP)
FO straightTimeCredit=13.00 TFP > FO guarantee minimum 11.60 TFP
FO guarantee credit = 13.00 TFP (actual credit exceeds FO minimum - no guarantee uplift needed)
Verify DynamoDB records for CA and FO show different guarantee credit values reflecting each crew member's individual calculation
DynamoDB coatable records for CA assignment and FO assignment on the same trip
CA DynamoDB record: guaranteeCredit=19.07 TFP. FO DynamoDB record: guaranteeCredit=13.00 TFP. Values are different as expected
